archives: two distinct completed parts survive New part and Finish; an older report opens with original notes
export: compact JSON has state, source reference and derived report without worksheet recipe or correction key
print: A4 PDF includes saved observations and hides commands
mobile: archive controls fit without horizontal overflow

import: preview and cancel write nothing; a separate browser imports and opens the identical report
reimport: an existing report is never overwritten
invalidFiles: future schema, forged report, foreign source and more than 2 MiB rejected without writes
ownership: deletion while another tab owns the part is refused

erase: cancel preserves data; explicit confirmation clears all interactive stores including future settings and old interactive flags, while preserving unrelated data and access
